records.jp: あの日、空から灰が降ってきて……<CR>人生は大きく変わってしまいました
records.en_original: That day the Ash started falling... It changed everything.
records.en_auxiliary: That day the Ash started falling... It changed everything.
records.en: That day, Ash fell from the sky...<CR>and my life changed drastically.

records.jp: 灰は、いろんな人の人生を狂わせたんだね
records.en_original: The Ash ruined a lot of lives, didn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: The Ash ruined a lot of lives, didn't it?
records.en: Ash threw so many people's lives into chaos, didn't it?

records.jp: はい。……でも、上手くいけば、<CR>再構築された世界に灰は降らない
records.en_original: That's right...but if we're lucky, the Ash won't fall in the rebuilt world.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right...but if we're lucky, the Ash won't fall in the rebuilt world.
records.en: Yes. But if things go well,<CR>no Ash will fall in the rebuilt world.

records.jp: わたしたちの人生は未来につながれて、<CR>正しい道に戻る……
records.en_original: Our lives are back on the right path, connected to the future.
records.en_auxiliary: Our lives are back on the right path, connected to the future.
records.en: Our lives will be connected to the future<CR>and return to their proper paths...

records.jp: そういうふうに考えていたんですが……<CR>少し納得がいっていないことがあって
records.en_original: Or at least I thought so. There's something still bothering me.
records.en_auxiliary: Or at least I thought so. There's something still bothering me.
records.en: That's how I thought of it...<CR>but there's one thing I can't quite accept.

records.jp: 納得がいっていないことって？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it?
records.en: What can't you accept?

records.jp: 正しい道って、なんだろうって
records.en_original: What does it even mean to be on the right path?
records.en_auxiliary: What does it even mean to be on the right path?
records.en: What is the 'proper path'?

records.jp: もし仮に、灰のない世界の人生が<CR>私にとっての正しい道だったとすると……
records.en_original: Suppose that life in a world without Ash was the right path for me.
records.en_auxiliary: Suppose that life in a world without Ash was the right path for me.
records.en: Suppose a life in a world without Ash<CR>is the proper path for me...

records.jp: 今の人生は間違った道、ということになってしまいます
records.en_original: It would mean that my life up until now has been wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: It would mean that my life up until now has been wrong.
records.en: Then my life now would be the wrong path.

records.jp: わたしは、そうは思いたくない
records.en_original: I don't want to look at it that way.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want to look at it that way.
records.en: I don't want to think that.

records.jp: たしかに辛いことも、大変なこともたくさんあった。<CR>でも、そこでしか得られないものもあったはずなんです
records.en_original: It's true that there was heartbreak and hardship. But there must also be something that can only be gained from those experiences.
records.en_auxiliary: It's true that there was heartbreak and hardship. But there must also be something that can only be gained from those experiences.
records.en: There were certainly many painful and difficult things.<CR>But there were also things I could only have gained there.

records.jp: この人生だってわたしの正しい道だった。<CR>それが否定されてしまうような気もしていて……
records.en_original: This life was mine. It almost feels like that's being denied.
records.en_auxiliary: This life was mine. It almost feels like that's being denied.
records.en: This life was also the right path for me.<CR>It feels as though that would be denied...

records.jp: 少しだけ怖いです
records.en_original: It's a little scary.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a little scary.
records.en: It's a little scary.

records.jp: そうだなぁ……。<CR>私からこうだって言えることは少ないけど――
records.en_original: You're right... There's not much I can say to that.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right... There's not much I can say to that.
records.en: Let's see...<CR>There isn't much I can say with certainty, but—

records.jp: きっと、どっちが正しくて<CR>どっちが間違ってるかなんて、ないんだろうね
records.en_original: But I don't think it's a matter of one being correct and the other being wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't think it's a matter of one being correct and the other being wrong.
records.en: I'm sure neither one is right<CR>or wrong.

records.jp: 今の世界のことを、<CR>次の世界では覚えていないかもしれない
records.en_original: We might not remember anything about this world in the next one.
records.en_auxiliary: We might not remember anything about this world in the next one.
records.en: We might not remember<CR>anything about this world in the next one.

records.jp: だとしても……私は、この世界での思い出や経験が、<CR>全部無駄になるとは思わないな
records.en_original: But even if that's the case, I don't think the memories and experiences we had in this world will be wasted.
records.en_auxiliary: But even if that's the case, I don't think the memories and experiences we had in this world will be wasted.
records.en: But even if that's true...<CR>I don't think our memories and experiences here will all be wasted.

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、<CR>意外としっかり自分の考えを持ってますよね
records.en_original: You've given this a surprising amount of thought, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You've given this a surprising amount of thought, Ao.
records.en: ...Hoshizaki-san, you have firmer opinions of your own<CR>than I expected.

records.jp: 意外は余計ですけど？
records.en_original: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
records.en: You could leave out 'than I expected,' you know?

records.jp: ……ふふ、失礼しました
records.en_original: Hehe... Sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... Sorry.
records.en: Hehe...forgive me.

records.jp: 灰がない世界で、どういう人生を歩むのか……<CR>まだ、想像がつきません
records.en_original: I still can't imagine what kind of life I would live in a world without Ash...
records.en_auxiliary: I still can't imagine what kind of life I would live in a world without Ash...
records.en: I still can't imagine what sort of life<CR>I'll lead in a world without Ash...

records.jp: でもわたしは、わたしの人生が好きです
records.en_original: But I enjoyed my life.
records.en_auxiliary: But I enjoyed my life.
records.en: But I like my life.

records.jp: 再構築された世界でも……<CR>わたしは、変わらず喫茶店のお手伝いをしていたい
records.en_original: I think I'd like to help at the cafe in the new world too.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'd like to help at the cafe in the new world too.
records.en: Even in the rebuilt world...<CR>I want to keep helping at a cafe, just as I always have.

records.jp: ……うん。きっと新しい詩帆さんも、<CR>エプロン姿の似合う素敵な店員さんになってるよ
records.en_original: Yeah... I bet the new Shiho will be a great barista. And look great in an apron too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I bet the new Shiho will be a great barista. And look great in an apron too.
records.en: Yeah. I'm sure the new Shiho-san will be<CR>a wonderful employee who looks great in an apron.

records.jp: ……ありがとうございます、星崎さん
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao.
records.en: Thank you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: もし実家が喫茶店になる道を辿らなかったら……<CR>自分で喫茶店を経営するのもいいかもしれませんね
records.en_original: If my parents decide not to open their cafe... Maybe I'll open my own.
records.en_auxiliary: If my parents decide not to open their cafe... Maybe I'll open my own.
records.en: If my family doesn't follow the path that leads to opening a cafe...<CR>perhaps I could run one myself.

records.jp: おお！
records.en_original: Ooh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh!
records.en: Ooh!

records.jp: その時はぜひ、<CR>星崎さんにも遊びに来てほしいです
records.en_original: If that happens, I'd love for you to come visit, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: If that happens, I'd love for you to come visit, Ao.
records.en: If that happens, I'd love you to come visit too,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Of course.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 美味しいコーヒーを淹れて、待ってます。<CR>だから、絶対に来てくださいね？
records.en_original: I'll have a delicious cup of coffee waiting for you, so be sure to stop by, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: I'll have a delicious cup of coffee waiting for you, so be sure to stop by, okay?
records.en: I'll brew delicious coffee and wait for you.<CR>So you absolutely have to come, okay?

records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 星崎さんに会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I want to see you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: わたしは、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
